claims.claim_text: Governor George W. Bush opposes both U.S. isolationism and imperial domination.
Governor George W. Bush opposes both using U.S. power to dominate other countries and indifference toward them.
Governor George W. Bush commits a prospective administration to a U.S. foreign policy characterized by modesty and humility.
The United States has unusually extensive opportunities to shape the world's future at the start of the twenty-first century.
The U.S. administration in office in 2000 has shown uncertainty and indecision in foreign policy.
Previous generations defended the United States through major crises.
The U.S. generation entering the twenty-first century can help the country thrive despite major economic, social, technological and weapons-related changes.
